cim: Artificial Intelligence in the Service of Human Dignity
cim_eredeti: Artificial Intelligence in the Service of Human Dignity
szoveg_eredeti:
A child touching the finger of a white robotic hand (Photo: Unsplash)

The rapid spread of artificial intelligence (AI) is one of the most significant transformations of our time. It is not merely a more powerful tool, but a form of mediation that affects the very way people perceive things, make decisions, and relate to others. For this reason, even before being a technical concern, it raises a profoundly anthropological question.

A proper assessment requires recognizing the ambivalent nature of every new discovery. What enhances human capabilities simultaneously raises new challenges, involving criteria for judgment and ways of interpreting reality. Every technical innovation is, in fact, embedded within a cultural context that guides its use and determines its meaning. When that context weakens, even the most sophisticated tools risk being employed according to a reductive logic.
